conditions: The array uses the ordinary variable-size declaration. The write is otherwise valid and enough memory is available. Reads refer to indices outside the extent at the time of access.
limitations: The statement describes the reference rules for variable-size arrays. It asserts no concrete diagnostic identifier, maximum allocation behavior, or actual execution.

triggers: Review a material Appeon correction, changed publisher payload or linked document edition, contrary scoped evidence, or a revised classifier boundary.

statement: For a variable-size PowerScript array in the documented model, writing to a positive index above its current extent can extend the array to that index. Reading above the established extent or below its lower bound causes a runtime error.
